ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 4

2. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 90
   C. 81
   D. 18

3. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 11
   C. 122
   D. 121

4. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 48
   C. 14
   D. 49

5. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 82
   C. 9
   D. 81

6. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 20
   C. 21
   D. 1

7. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 10

8. Solve for x: x + 6 = 10. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 5
   C. 10
   D. 4

9. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 12
   C. 42
   D. 24

10. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 17
   C. 27
   D. 31

11. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 72
   B. 17
   C. 73
   D. 1

12. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 3
   C. 29
   D. 28

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
